title: Sticky MAC & Port Security
description: Use sticky MAC addresses to dynamically learn and secure devices.
scenario: Use sticky MAC addresses to dynamically learn and secure devices.

concepts.title: Sticky MAC
concepts.body: Sticky MAC dynamically learns MAC addresses and saves them to running-config. They persist until the config is cleared.

concepts.title: How Sticky Works
concepts.body: The first MAC seen on the port becomes sticky. It is added to running-config and the MAC table.
concepts.code:
Learned MAC → saved to running-config
Sticky entries survive reload if saved

concepts.title: Verifying Sticky MACs
concepts.body: "show port-security" shows sticky MACs. "show mac address-table" shows them as STATIC entries.
concepts.code:
SW1# show port-security
Secure MAC Addresses:
00:1B:2F:3C:4D:5E (sticky)
